notes.title: 🍌 Hidden Bananas is part of Steam Next Fest
notes.content: [h2]🎮 Play the free [b]Next Fest demo[/b] and share your feedback!🍌[/h2][p][/p][h3] [i]Hidden Bananas[/i] is joining [b]Steam Next Fest[/b] from [b]June 9 to 16[/b]![/h3][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3694240"][/dynamiclink][/p][h3]🔍 In this charming hidden object game, your mission is simple: find all the hidden bananas scattered across colorful and creative environments. Each level offers a new challenge full of surprises.[/h3][p][/p][h3]✨ Why wishlist [i]Hidden Bananas[/i]?[/h3][h3]✅ Be the first to know when the game launches [/h3][h3]✅ Help us grow and reach more players [/h3][p][/p][h3]📅 [b]Steam Next Fest[/b] runs from [b]June 9 to 16[/b][/h3][h3]💛 Thanks for your support — and happy banana hunting![/h3][p]— the [i]Hidden Bananas[/i] Team[/p]

notes.title: 🎉 Hidden Tomatoes: Farm Frenzy - Demo Now Available! 🍅🚜
